thread.title: Microsoft's stock surges toward another record high

author: morningstar.com
title: Microsoft's stock surges toward another record high
text:
Shares of Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) surged 1.5% toward a second-straight record high, in the wake the software giant's better-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter results (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/microsoft-stock-rallies-after-earnings-as-analysts-overwhelmingly-raise-targets-2018-07-20). The stock's rally has lifted Microsoft's market capitalization to $828.3 billion to close in on Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL), which is the third-largest U.S. company by market cap, at $835.5 billion. Microsoft is still well behind second-place Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) at $874.6 billion and first-place Apple Inc. (AAPL) at $935.2 billion. Microsoft's stock rose 1.8% on Friday after results were reported late Thursday. It has run up 26% year to date, while the Nasdaq Composite has rallied 13% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 1.2%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1043ET
